title: A daily scored pick of the best job posts
lead: Collects vacancies from open feeds, scores each against your profile and sends up to 10 best cards a day to Telegram.
problem: Suitable vacancies are scattered across feeds, with many duplicates and wrong roles. The need was one short daily list.
built: Collection from open feeds and public channels, with no account logins.
Duplicate merging, and filtering by rules such as wrong role or not remote.
The bot scores every vacancy out of 100 and sends only those scoring 55 or more: at most 10 a day, no repeats.
Card buttons (Open vacancy, Copy text, Sent, Skip, Not mine) remember your answer; Not mine is taken into account later.
A letter draft from your approved wording; the model's reply drafts are checked against your profile facts, so it does not invent experience, and figures are checked against your facts.
steps: Feeds are collected without logging in anywhere.
Duplicates are merged and wrong roles are filtered out.
Each vacancy is scored against your profile.
Up to 10 cards a day reach Telegram, and your button presses train the next pick.
offer: Setup for your profile and rules.
Cards with buttons in your Telegram.
not_included: Automatic sending of applications; Closed channels; CAPTCHA bypass; Hosting.
